decisions.reason: The turnaround management software has had its own page since launch and anchors the firm's announced airport digitalization direction, so its substantial investment and visible commitment make continuation very likely.
The connectivity module was upgraded from a mention to a dedicated page in 2024, signaling growing public commitment, and as an enabling layer for the apron suite it is central to the strategy.
Billing software gained a dedicated page in 2024, showing increased commitment, though it is somewhat more peripheral to the firm's electrical equipment core than the apron modules.

Equipment monitoring builds directly on the firm's hardware business and was promoted to its own page in 2024, so management will attribute any weak uptake to the long airport sales cycles and persist.
